description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the DetectLivingFace operation in the facebody category
description_zh: 本文为您介绍人脸人体（facebody）类目下的人脸活体检测DetectLivingFace的语法及示例
name: DetectLivingFace

fields.help_en:
The Base64-encoded string of the image. If both the URL and Base64-encoded string are provided, the URL takes precedence.
For more information about how to perform Base64 encoding on files, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
fields.help_zh:
图像Base64编码字符串。当与URL方式共存时，URL方式优先。
文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
fields.name: image_data

fields.help_en:
The URL of the image to be detected. Each element in the JSON array is an image detection task structure. A maximum of 10 elements are supported, which means up to 10 images can be detected at the same time. We recommend that you use OSS URLs in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or in OSS buckets in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

For this API operation, the system automatically converts the OSS URL to an internal network URL before downloading the file. Therefore, calling this API operation does not incur OSS traffic fees
fields.help_zh:
待检测的图像URL地址。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个图片检测任务结构体（image表）。最多支持10个元素，即同时最多对10张图片进行检测。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

对于该接口，系统会自动将OSS链接地址转成内网地址然后再下载文件，所以调用该接口并不会产生OSS流量计费
fields.name: image_url

FaceNumber.description_en:
The number of faces detected in a single image.
If no face is detected, the value of FaceNumber is 0
FaceNumber.description_zh:
单张图片检测到的人脸数量。
如果未检测到人脸，FaceNumber返回为0

ImageURL.description_en: The image URL in the corresponding request
ImageURL.description_zh: 对应请求中的图像URL地址

Results.description_en: The returned results. If the call is successful, the returned results contain one or more elements
Results.description_zh: 返回结果。调用成功时返回结果中包含一个或多个元素

Frames.description_en: [Deprecated] When the input image is a long image (aspect ratio greater than 3:1), the original image is cropped into several images with normal aspect ratios. The frames field stores the cropped screenshots from the image that are identified as recaptured
Frames.description_zh: （该字段已废弃）输入图像为长图（长宽比大于3:1）时，会把原图截成几张正常比例的图，frames保存从图像中裁剪出来的而且是翻拍命中的截图

Rate.description_en:
The probability that the result belongs to the category. Valid values: [0.00, 100.00]. A larger value indicates a higher probability that the result belongs to the category.
If no face is detected, the value of Rate is 100
Rate.description_zh:
结果为该分类的概率，取值范围为[0.00,100.00]。取值越大，表示属于该分类的概率越大。
如果未检测到人脸，则Rate返回为100

Label.description_en:
The category of the detection result. Valid values:
normal: live photo
liveness: recaptured photo
If no face is detected, the value of Label is liveness
Label.description_zh:
检测结果的分类，取值包括：
normal：活体照片
liveness：翻拍照片

如果未检测到人脸，则Label返回为liveness

MessageTips.description_en:
The prompt message.
If the input face is blurry, occluded, or at a large angle, the following prompt message is returned: `blurred, occluded or large angle face, please check.`  
If no face is detected, the following prompt message is returned: `no face detected, try again please.`
MessageTips.description_zh:
提示信息。
如输入模糊、遮挡或大角度等的人脸，则返回提示信息：`blurred, occluded or large angle face, please check.`  
如未检测到人脸，则返回提示信息：`no face detected, try again please.`
MessageTips.example: blurred, occluded or large angle face, please check.

Rate.description_en: The probability that the result belongs to the category. Valid values: [0.00, 100.00]. A larger value indicates a higher probability that the result belongs to the category
Rate.description_zh: 结果为该分类的概率，取值范围为[0.00,100.00]。表示属于该分类的概率越大

Rect.description_en: The information about the face detection bounding box

Height.description_en: The height of the bounding box

Left.description_en: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding box
Left.description_zh: 检测框左上角的点x坐标

Top.description_en: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding box
Top.description_zh: 检测框左上角的点y坐标

Width.description_en: The width of the bounding box

Suggestion.description_en:
The recommended action to execute. Valid values:
pass: The live object in the image is captured directly. No further action is required.
review: The live object in the image may be recaptured. We recommend that you confirm before proceeding.
block: The live object in the image is highly likely to be recaptured. We recommend that you execute What to do next.
If no face is detected, the value of Suggestion is block
Suggestion.description_zh:
建议您执行的操作，取值范围如下：
pass：图片中的活体对象来自直接拍摄，无需进行其余操作。
review：图片中的活体对象可能来自翻拍，建议您确认后再进行操作。
block：图片中的活体对象大概率来自翻拍，建议您执行后续操作。
如果未检测到人脸，则Suggestion返回为block

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the detection task
